subject.why: Clearly depicts a chunky, candy-striped hula hoop with a red bow as requested.

category.why: The hoop floats in three-quarter view with no ground or surface beneath, set against an orange radiating ray background.

clean.why: Free of text, numbers, UI, card frames, and characters.

framing.why: The hoop is well-centered with ample margins on all sides and a bold silhouette.

colour.why: Vibrant and saturated palette with the blue and white hoop contrasting sharply against the warm orange background.

detail.why: Clean chunky forms without noisy micro-details or cluttered extra props.

style.why: The volume has an unnatural pinch and dent along the bottom-left curve, and the stripe texture glitches into awkward chevrons rather than wrapping smoothly around the tube.

bg_colour.why: background is orange (99% of the background); planned orange

fix: Smooth out the dented crease along the lower-left tube and ensure the candy stripes wrap continuously without chevroning or glitching.
